an5.14:2.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako saddho hoti. saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ:
an5.14:2.3: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
an5.14:3.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako āraddha viriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahāṇāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
an5.14:4.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvato satimā hoti: paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā.
an5.14:5.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako vivicceva kāmehi …pe… [paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ …pe…
an5.14:6.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
